fields.acceptance: A testscript (extend autonomous-gate-rule.txtar or add autonomy-accept-rule.txtar) shows rhiza accept --rule autonomy refused as usage while rhiza.autonomy.accept is owner and accepted (the log entry records rule autonomy) while it is auto; rule autonomous outside an autonomous run is still refused as before
fields.statement: rhiza accept takes rule autonomy, recording that the owner's standing rhiza.autonomy.accept setting made the move; it is refused as usage unless rhiza.autonomy.accept is auto, and rule autonomous keeps meaning a move an unfinished autonomous run made

set.acceptance: A testscript ends a plan run whose change set adds an intent served by two draft change sets: normal (a record change set, landed after the interview) with rhiza.autonomy.accept owner, both are proposed, none accepted, the landed record is left as it is, and run status --json names rhiza accept --rule owner; normal with accept auto and a passing review, both are accepted with rule autonomy; autonomous (an intention change set, since a milestone plan never runs autonomous) with a passing review, both are accepted with rule autonomous and reasons naming the run; autonomous with a question left by the review, none is accepted and the command exits non-zero naming the question; once the arbiter's Decision answers it, both are accepted. A run on an intention change set that serves an existing intent proposes that change set itself.
set.statement: rhiza run gate ends a plan: it proposes each draft among the plan's change sets (the run's change set and every change set that serves an intent the run's change set adds), leaving landed or accepted ones as they are. In a normal run it follows rhiza.autonomy.accept: when it is auto and the plan's review passed, it accepts each with rule autonomy; when it is owner, or the review has not passed, they wait for the owner's rhiza accept --rule owner, which run status names. In an autonomous run it accepts each with rule autonomous once the review passed and every question from the review is answered, and accepts nothing while a question from the review is open.
